**Build's clean.** Exit 0, `44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors`.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler passes `retryCount`. Was throwing on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted `true`/`false`, but unset flags now come through as `undefined`. Added an `undefined → false` case.

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc), not build-breaking.

Next: nothing. Build passes.
